title: Computing fixed point free automorphisms of graphs
summary: In 1981, Lubiw proved that the fixed point free automorphism problem (FPFAut) is NP-complete: given a graph G, determine whether there exists an automorphism that maps no vertex of G to itself. We revisit this problem and prove that FPFAut remains NP-complete when restricted to split, bipartite, k-subdivided, and H-free graphs, if H is not an induced subgraph of P_4. The class of P_4-free graphs receives the special name of cographs.
